To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the use of UAVs in WSNs is a promising technology, that it is possible to integrate UAVs in terrestrial WSNs, that the use of a UAV in a terrestrial network reduces the energy consumed by the network and increases the lifetime of the nodes in the network.
the integration of small scale drone in terrestrial wireless sensor network is a promising approach for data gathering in environmental monitoring.
the use of a UAV for data gathering in WSN is an effective solution for the network lifetime and the data gathering process.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of an efficient data gathering protocol, based on clustering and UAV integration, for a WSN.
the design, development and testing of a system that allows the integration of drones in a terrestrial wireless network, for the purpose of data gathering and data reduction.
a new approach to data gathering and routing for wireless sensor network, by integrating a small scale Unmanned Aeryal Vehicle.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the use of a UAV as a data gatherer in a wireless sensor network can be very effective in reducing the energy consumption of the static nodes, and therefore extend the lifetime of the whole network.
, the use of small scale drones in a wireless sensor network, improves the overall performance of the network, in terms of data gathering and network lifetime.
the UAV can be used to improve the performance of the WSN by reducing the communication cost, increasing the coverage area, and extending the lifetime of the WSN.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the use of drones in a wireless sensor network is a promising solution for data gathering and data fusion.
the UAV can be considered as a mobile sink that can be used to extend the lifetime of the sensor network.
we have developed a wireless sensor network architecture that is capable of integrating a small scale unmanned aerial vehicle for data gathering.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the integration of small scale drone in wireless sensor network is a promising approach to improve data gathering in a wireless network.

the use of a drone in the network can significantly reduce the energy consumption of the network, and extend the lifetime of the static nodes, and that the clustering algorithms that are designed to minimize the energy consumption of static wireless sensor networks can be adapted to take advantage of the mobility of the drones in the network.
, the use of drones in a WSN, can be a viable alternative in terms of energy efficiency, and can be an interesting solution in terms of network lifetime.
